thread:
ana: Quick triage: noticed dashboard heatmap and sparklines regress in US-canary after last runtime bump. Median main-thread frame time +1.6s.
kevin: Which runtime bump? the widget split + new prefetch routing that landed yesterday?
ana: yes, runtime 2.14.3 + routing PR #3340. Heatmap freezes when opening a single pane with ~2000 points.
lee: I grabbed a trace. Looks like two things: (1) a bigger bundle due to telemetry proximal module, (2) synchronous JSON.parse of a 600KB payload on main thread. Flame: main->telemetry.setup ~120ms, main->metrics.parseSync ~900ms.
kevin: Are we double-fetching? our prefetch now requests both raw + downsampled when timeframe change happens. Could be the reason.
ana: Confirmed: network shows /v2/series?raw=1 (580KB) then /v2/series?downsample=1 (410KB) within 50ms. Both responses are parsed before handing to worker.
lee: Worker bootstrap is async; telemetry lib currently eager-imports and registers callbacks that call parseSync. If telemetry triggers parse before worker ready, that's the issue.
ana: Short mitigation idea: gate telemetry-init behind navigator.scheduling.isInputPending or preferPost to push heavy parse off main thread. Or quick fix: dynamic import telemetry after worker is ready.
kevin: Also can we change prefetch routing policy to avoid requesting raw + downsampled simultaneously? Maybe route to only downsampled for wide time ranges. That was a config knob but someone changed it.
ana: I reverted the routing config in canary to PREFETCH_STRATEGY=downsample-first. Deploy bot: deploy-bot: rollout r-2026-03-21-09-config -> started -> id dpl-6061112240.
lee: After revert, median main-thread parsing dropped from 1.9s -> 420ms on my sample. Still seeing rare spikes when a 1MB payload is parsed.
kevin: Long-term we should: (A) stream JSON (ndjson) from metrics API so we can incremental parse in worker, (B) ensure telemetry client is lazy-init or worker-aware, (C) remove polyfill pulled in by telemetry proxy.
ana: Filed followups: #3349 (metrics ndjson endpoint), #3350 (telemetry lazy-init), #3351 (polyfill strip).
lee: Small quick win: update chart adapter to postMessage raw text to worker and parse there via JSON.parse + structuredClone of result. I'll prototype.
kevin: Beware of structuredClone perf costs across large arrays; streaming + incremental decode in worker is better. But prototype is fine for short-term.
perf-bot: perf-bot: metric dashboard.render.main_thread_ms recorded for rollout r-2026-03-21-09-config.
ana: Good. Keep canary for 2 hours and then decide progressive rollout. Also add telemetry event dashboard.parse.source = main|worker and include parse_bytes.
lee: I'll open the small PR for worker-parse proto and attach a test harness.
ana: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene after 2h window to decide next steps. :thumbsup:
